transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with these overwhelming, intrusive thoughts that I just can't seem to get out of my head. It's gotten so bad that I feel this uncontrollable urge to perform certain repetitive actions just to quiet the intense anxiety they cause. I'm just so exhausted and really need some help.

latest_inference.note: The patient endorses hallmark symptoms of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder, including intrusive thoughts (obsessions) and repetitive behaviors (compulsions) driven by anxiety. These symptoms align specifically with OCD and are not characteristic of other disorders in the allowed list such as Generalized Anxiety Disorder or Major Depressive Disorder, which lack the obsessions and compulsions core to OCD. No other diagnoses from the allowed list better account for this symptom pattern. Previously there were no candidates, and now, based on the patient's description, OCD is the only plausible diagnosis.
